blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday held the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. responsible for the recent school shootings, including the latest incident in South Cotabato that left three students dead. In a statement, Duterte said the three fatal school shooting incidents reported this year underscored how the protection of children […]...
